gen-gf-castoro-titling-gf-padyakke-expan: Castoro Titling slashes between fat strokes and hairlines, with gaps between its glyphs. Padyakke Expanded One answers with a serif of round, wide-mouthed letters that look bent from a single wire.
gen-gf-castoro-titling-gf-stint-ultra-ex: Stint Ultra Expanded is a serif of pipe-cleaner letters, each one floating off from its neighbor with open counters. Make the Castoro Titling heading small and its hairlines would nearly vanish.
gen-gf-cause-fs-bespoke-serif: Bespoke Serif carries the slight heft shifts of a stone-carved inscription, thin strokes about half the thick ones. Under Cause, whose lines are rod-stock uniform, it feels dignified and weighty, though it isn't built for long paragraphs.
gen-gf-cause-fs-erode: Erode is a text serif with a tall middle band, shallow ascenders and soft ebbs of stroke weight that never turn stark. Cause is best at being a tube-like, hand-drawn greeting; Erode is best at steady, dignified lines.
gen-gf-cause-gf-bhutuka-expanded-one: Cause has a hand-drawn e that opens wide, with diagonals matching its stems. BhuTuka Expanded One, a serif of curvy, unclamped letters, slows the pace to a leisurely walk across a longer passage.
gen-gf-cause-gf-kiwi-maru: Kiwi Maru sets terminals far from the stem and gives its body copy generous letterspace, with round o shapes of constant wall. Next to Cause's hand-drawn warmth, the strongest quality is that friendly, traditional mix.
gen-gf-cause-gf-orbit: The wide-open e and diagonals matching the stems give Cause a friendly, hand-drawn voice, which Orbit tones down with rope-like stems. Over a longer passage Orbit's curves stop short and its characters float apart, so the sans reads lightly.
gen-gf-cause-gf-padyakke-expanded-one: Friendly handwriting meets wide-mouthed serifs here. Padyakke Expanded One spreads its glyphs like knots on a slack rope, and its round bowls keep their walls uniform, so give this body size generously while Cause stays modest.
gen-gf-cause-gf-science-gothic: Science Gothic reads one letter at a time, with stroke ends set far apart and no thick and thin parts. Cause does friendly, hand-drawn greeting best, while Science Gothic does plain sans clarity best.
gen-gf-cause-gf-stint-ultra-expanded: Stint Ultra Expanded floats each character apart, pipe-cleaner style. Cause is best at a friendly, hand-drawn welcome with its wide e, while Stint Ultra Expanded, a serif with open counters, is best at traditional authority.
